$comment: Sound effects and music beds for the engine; a sound is named by its file name without .wav. All were generated in code with numpy for this project (no samples, no recordings), 48 kHz (the two music beds are kept as mono 32 kHz IMA ADPCM WAV to stay small; the engine decodes every sound through ffmpeg). Licence: the repository's MIT licence.

sounds.name: blip
sounds.what: a short blip, a small UI event

sounds.name: coin
sounds.what: a coin: a cost or a win

sounds.name: marker
sounds.what: a marker stroke: a box or an underline draws in

sounds.name: music
sounds.what: music bed, a soft lo-fi loop at 96 bpm

sounds.name: thunk
sounds.what: a dull thunk: something is set down
